question: Train A running at a speed of 72 km/hr takes 24 seconds to completely cross train B running at 63 km/hr in the opposite direction. The length of train B is 1.5 times the length of train A. Train B crosses a bridge completely in 62 seconds. The length of the bridge (in m) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Train A = 72 km/hr = 72 × 1000 ÷ 3600 = 20 m/s

Speed of Train B = 63 km/hr = 63 × 1000 ÷ 3600 = 17.5 m/s

Time taken for Train A to cross Train B = 24 seconds

Length of Train B = 1.5 × Length of Train A

Time taken by Train B to cross a bridge = 62 seconds

**Formula used:**

Relative speed when trains move in opposite directions: Speedᵣₑₗₐₜᵢvₑ = SpeedA + SpeedB
